svg.text: Every feature means one thing and is always in the same place. An empty dashed box = that thing is gone.
FLAG (top, right of the pole) = who has more pieces
Empty dashed box = equal. White flag = White is ahead. Black
flag = Black is ahead. Number of bars = how many pawns ahead
Left chimney = long castle (O-O-O), right chimney = short
castle (O-O). Filled black = yes. Dashed = no.
Same wall colour + different band = sister openings, e.g.
The 8x8 wall IS the board: left to right = a to h, bottom to
top = 1 to 8. White lives at the bottom, Black at the top.
YELLOW DOT under a column = en passant
A pawn on that column can be captured en passant right now.
Left fence = long castle (O-O-O), right fence = short castle
Light sky = White to move. Dark sky = Black to move.
White piece = white shape with black edge. Black piece = black shape with white edge.
